articles.title: Nepalese Finance Minister Swarnim Wagle Stirs Political Storm in India
articles.summary: Nepalese Finance Minister Swarnim Wagle sparked a major political backlash by stating in India that the era of anti-Indian nationalism in Nepal has ended. articles.title: AI Stocks Have Lost Over $1 Trillion.The AI Bubble Warning Bell Is Ringing Louder
articles.summary: More than $1 trillion in market capitalisation was wiped from 20 of the world’s most valuable AI and semiconductor stocks during the week ending October 15, 2026, as investors reassessed the cost of financing the technology boom. Nvidia, AMD, Micron, SK Hynix, Samsung Electronics, SoftBank and several European chipmakers came under pressure.

articles.title: Police Detain YouTuber Dhruv Rathee During Bengaluru Protest
articles.summary: YouTuber Dhruv Rathee was detained by police in Gurugram on October 10 after joining Cockroach Janta Party protests in Bengaluru. The movement demands the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar over alleged electoral roll irregularities. Rathee shifted from online commentary to street activism, while political leaders like Rahul Gandhi publicly backed the demonstrations.
articles.title_hi: बेंगलुरु विरोध प्रदर्शन के दौरान पुलिस ने यूट्यूबर ध्रुव राठी को हिरासत में लिया
articles.summary_hi: बेंगलुरु में कॉकरोच जनता पार्टी के विरोध प्रदर्शन में शामिल होने के बाद यूट्यूबर ध्रुव राठी को 10 अक्टूबर को गुरुग्राम में पुलिस ने हिरासत में लिया था। आंदोलन कथित मतदाता सूची में अनियमितताओं पर मुख्य चुनाव आयुक्त ज्ञानेश कुमार के इस्तीफे की मांग करता है। राठी ऑनलाइन कमेंटरी से सड़क पर सक्रियता की ओर स्थानांतरित हो गए, जबकि राहुल गांधी जैसे राजनीतिक नेताओं ने सार्वजनिक रूप से प्रदर्शनों का समर्थन किया।
articles.title_hinglish: bengaluru virodha pradarshana ke daurana pulisa ne yutyubara dhruva rathi ko hirasata men liya

articles.title: Kerala Blasters' takeover and Inter Kashi's wage row show money pressures on ISL teams

articles.title: PM Modi to visit Uttar Pradesh and Odisha on October 25
articles.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi will visit Uttar Pradesh and Odisha on Sunday (October 25), where he will inaugurate a garment manufacturing facility in Varanasi, witness the Indian Air Force's aerial display at Namo Ghat and inaugurate the Reserve Bank of India's Data Centre and Cybersecurity Training Institute in Bhubaneswar, according to a press release.

articles.title: Ind AS 118: India Inc gears up for big changes to financial reporting
articles.summary: Indias largest companies are preparing for the implementation of Ind AS 118, which may impact financial reporting. Audit committees are discussing transition plans while awaiting final rules and guidance from regulatory bodies.

articles.title: Indian victim compensation scheme faces severe delays and payout gaps

The research highlights significant state-wise payout gaps across the country. articles.title: UNESCO adds three Indian sites to Tentative List, from Andaman volcanoes to Chhattisgarh’s
articles.summary: UNESCO has added three Indian properties to its World Heritage Tentative List: the Karst-mud-volcano Complex of Baratang, the Andaman Subduction Volcanoes and the Sirpur Cultural and Archaeological Landscape. Located in the Andaman and Nicobar Islands and Chhattisgarh, the sites represent Indias geological diversity and archaeological heritage. Tentative-list inclusion is a preliminary step, not final World Heritage recognition.

articles.title: UNESCO Adds Three New Indian Sites to Tentative List, Highlighting Chhattisgarh Temples
articles.summary: Inclusion on the Tentative List serves as a mandatory prerequisite for any property before a country can formally nominate it for full UNESCO World Heritage status. ​While placement on the Tentative List underscores the global geological and cultural value of these locations, it represents an initial nomination step and does not guarantee automatic World Heritage inscription.

articles.title: Indian companies can file annual financial statements till December 31
articles.summary: The Ministry of Corporate Affairs (MCA) has extended the deadline for companies to file their annual financial statements for the fiscal year 2025-26. The new deadline is now December 31, 2026. The move comes after stakeholders raised concerns over difficulties in submitting these statutory filings through the MCA 21 portal.
articles.title_hi: भारतीय कंपनियां 31 दिसंबर तक वार्षिक वित्तीय विवरण दाखिल कर सकती हैं
articles.summary_hi: कॉरपोरेट मामलों के मंत्रालय (एमसीए) ने कंपनियों के लिए वित्तीय वर्ष 2025-26 के लिए अपने वार्षिक वित्तीय विवरण दाखिल करने की समय सीमा बढ़ा दी है। नई समय सीमा अब 31 दिसंबर, 2026 है। यह कदम हितधारकों द्वारा एमसीए 21 पोर्टल के माध्यम से इन वैधानिक फाइलिंग को जमा करने में कठिनाइयों पर चिंता व्यक्त करने के बाद आया है।

articles.summary_hinglish: koraporeta mamalon ke mantralaya (emasie) ne kanpaniyon ke lie vittiya varsha 2025-26 ke lie apane varshika vittiya vivarana dakhila karane ki samaya sima badhaा di hai। naee samaya sima aba 31 disanbar, 2026 hai। yaha kadama hitadharakon dvara emasie 21 portala ke madhyama se ina vaidhanika phailinga ko jama karane men kathinaiyon para chinta vyakta karane ke bada aaya hai।

articles.title: IAF keeping close watch on Indo-Pacific, boosting capabilities to protect national

articles.title: Kharge demands voting by ballot papers, annulment of polls for last 2 yrs
articles.summary: Kharge alleges vote theft in four states and attacks the BJP over caste discrimination. articles.title: Benjamin Netanyahu faces crucial Israeli electoral test on security and accountability

articles.title: Delhi Steps Up NCR Coordination to Curb Winter Pollution
